sources.entry: ID Photo API AI - Passport Photo API to convert regular photo to passport photo. #freemium

summary.name: IDPhoto.ai ID Photo API
summary.one_liner: A paid API that turns a regular portrait into a compliant passport, visa, or ID photo by removing the background, aligning and cropping the face, and checking specification issues.
use_cases: Turn a casual portrait into a US or UK passport photo
Prepare visa photos for Schengen or China applications
Add passport photo capture to a travel or app product
Standardize employee badge or directory photos
Generate printable passport photo sheets at a retail counter
summary.what_it_does: The API takes a portrait and a specification code (for example us-passport, uk-passport, china-visa) and returns a processed photo. It removes and replaces the background while trying to keep edges around hair and clothing, and positions and crops the face by output size, head size and eye line. It reports detectable issues such as tilted or turned heads, uneven lighting, blur, eyeglasses or non-neutral expressions. Output can be Base64 data, a temporary URL, or a print-ready layout. The spec catalog can also be queried so products can list supported document types.
notable: 300+ photo specifications across 200+ countries, with custom specs on request
Base64 output option so no images are stored on the service; URL delivery via temporary S3 storage
US and EU API endpoints; other regions on request
Quality checks report issues like glasses, expression and lighting
caveats: Starts at $0.20 per photo; volume pricing requires contacting sales
Final acceptance of photos is decided by the relevant government agency or application platform
Some features such as biometric verification, face matching and print-and-mail are available only on request
The page says US and UK passports need unedited photographs, so the fix-passport-photo service does not apply to them
